title: Maximum coordinate influence
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$. Its maximum influence is the largest, over all coordinates, of the influence of that coordinate on $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
